summary: First end-to-end test of Supreme House. Backend: 34/34 pytest tests PASSED covering auth, demo-login (6 roles), register/me, home content, properties (views increment), leads+appointments mirroring, buyer-requests, admin hype (boost/+views/+shares/badges/global), admin site edits (ticker/stats/neigh/poles), services CRUD, buyer requests admin CRUD, VIP links CRUD + public fetch, users list/update, and role protection (agent -> 403, unauth -> 401). Frontend: Home renders ALL sections (ticker, hero, buyer requests, demo-live-btn, 6 neighborhoods, 6 stats, 6 poles, 4 concluded, 3 action cards) with scroll height ~10.7k. Advisor dialog opens, submits, shows advisor-success. Login as admin/admin123 -> /dashboard with all 7 tabs. Immobili page: map toggle (map-wrap), filters, cat-prop-0 click -> property detail with all pd-* testids. ChiCerca insert-request dialog + submit works. Servizi shows 9 service tiles (testid 'service-0..8', not 'svc-tile-*'). Demo B&B owner panel loads with charts, income, bonifici. VIP link generation produces a working /vip/{token} page with owner_name, compatible_buyers count, and vip-sign-btn. Overall quality is excellent.

ui_bugs.issue: Map tiles show 'API KEY REQUIRED' overlay — the configured tile provider (likely MapTiler/Mapbox/Stadia/CARTO) requires an API key not provided. Leaflet dark map on Immobili '/immobili' map-wrap and property detail is not rendering real tiles.

issues: After backend test mutated ticker items to ['A','B'] via PUT /api/admin/ticker, home ticker now shows A/B dots. Not a functional bug but previous admin edits persist (expected). Main agent may want to re-seed ticker or add a reset endpoint.

action_items: Fix Leaflet dark map tiles: either switch to a key-free provider (e.g., OSM default, CartoDB voyager/dark_all without key, OpenFreeMap) or load MAPTILER/MAPBOX key via env. Currently tiles display 'API KEY REQUIRED'.

(Optional) Re-seed ticker to Italian market items (automatic seeding only runs when ticker collection is empty, so my ['A','B'] edit persists). Main agent can call PUT /api/admin/ticker to restore nice content.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: 'CORS_ORIGINS=*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject credentialed CORS with wildcard. Not fatal here (Bearer tokens in headers, not cookies) but should be set to explicit origins for a production-grade build.
server.py: on_startup writes /app/memory/test_credentials.md on every boot — may overwrite custom edits. OK but worth noting.

server.py update_property / update_service / update_neigh / update_pole blindly $set the whole body (minus id/_id). No field whitelist, no validation. Any client can inject arbitrary fields (e.g., 'password_hash' into users was correctly whitelisted — good — but other endpoints are not).
No pagination on list endpoints (e.g., /api/leads to_list(500)). Fine for MVP seed data but revisit.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); FastAPI prefers lifespan context managers (deprecation warning).
Properties increments views on every GET including by admins/bots — intended behavior per spec but could inflate counts.
Frontend: Servizi service tiles use testid 'service-0..8' but review brief referenced generic 'service tile' — fine, documented.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed leads/buyer-requests/services/vip-links (services and vip-links are cleaned up in-test). TEST Mario lead and TEST Advisor lead remain in DB from UI tests; TEST VIP Owner link also remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 34 backend pytest tests green. Only visible issue is Leaflet map tiles missing API key ('API KEY REQUIRED' text appears over map area). All data-testid attributes referenced in the review brief are present and wired correctly. VIP flow, login (admin + demo), dashboard tabs, Immobili map toggle + filters, property detail, chi-cerca dialog, servizi tiles, B&B pannello — all verified working on live preview URL. Ticker now shows ['A','B'] due to admin test mutation; harmless.
rca of the issue: Map tiles 'API KEY REQUIRED': frontend Leaflet component is configured with a tile URL template that requires a provider API key (likely stadiamaps.com dark theme or similar). Fix: in the Leaflet TileLayer URL, use a free tile provider that doesn't require a key, e.g., https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}.png with proper attribution; or inject the API key via environment variable and pass it into the URL template.
